record.body:
## Interfaces

Routes: `#/` renders ProductIndex, `#/area/<s>` renders Area, `#/effort/<n>` renders Home. router.ts adds `effort` and `effortName()`. detail.ts adds `effortHref` and `closeDetail(fallback)`. lib/state/areas.ts holds the pure functions groupByArea, areaRollup, routeEffort, railItems, breadcrumbParts, firstSentence and startedIdeas. Breadcrumb.svelte and Rail.svelte replace the top-bar crumbs and EffortRail.svelte. polling.svelte.ts follows the effort route and exports leaveHref(). SideRail renders only at the effort level. Backend load_areas reads composer:placement; the response shape is unchanged. e2e/serve.py seeds an area and a placement.

## Assumptions

The second review read only the brief, the diff and the tree, and did not run Playwright or basedpyright. The parent ran e2e, lint, svelte-check, build, ruff, basedpyright and the area Python tests at the final head. The composer schema exists for the e2e seed.

## Invariants

Hash routing only: holds. The product index and the area page write nothing: holds. An idea never renders among the efforts: holds. The URL decides the selected effort: holds for the effort route; leaveHref now resolves the effort from the route. An effort belongs to at most one area: holds.

## Conflicts

None between work items. One fix task changed sideRailCalm.test.ts expectations (journal Back and Esc end on the effort page). The user accepted a mount-line edit to dialogs.test.ts (decision dialogs-test-mount-route).


Renewed at head 775ca3e84 after the last fix task; no interface changed since the second review except the move of the key handler to src/lib/state/keys.ts.
